review_scope: Phase 1 fixture-gated Insider Activity desktop reference comparison

accepted_differences.reason: Phase 1 is intentionally fixture-only and must disclose that the displayed names, values, and dates are illustrative rather than SEC filing evidence.
The bundled fixture carries a deliberately small deterministic price and transaction series; the implementation preserves the reference layout and interaction model without inventing additional data.
The implementation renders only the bounded bundled fixture rows, while the source mockup illustrates a denser future production dataset.
